Unified Atlassian Cloud CLI

Usage: atlassian-cli [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  jira        Jira commands
  confluence  Confluence commands
  bitbucket   Bitbucket commands [aliases: bb]
  jsm         Jira Service Management commands
  opsgenie    Opsgenie commands
  bamboo      Bamboo commands
  auth        Authentication commands
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -p, --profile <PROFILE>  Profile to use from config file
      --config <CONFIG>    Path to config file (defaults to ~/.atlassian-cli/config.yaml)
  -f, --format <FORMAT>    Output format for command results (table, json, yaml, csv, quiet,
                           markdown) [default: table] [possible values: table, json, yaml, csv,
                           quiet, markdown]
      --envelope           Wrap JSON/YAML list output in {"data": [...], "count": N} envelope
      --debug              Enable verbose logging
  -h, --help               Print help
  -V, --version            Print version
